press_references.value: Taktile Unveils AI Agents Enabling Banks to Process 5x More SMB Loans Without Extra Headcount

product_launches.description: Taktile launched fully customizable AI agents to automate SMB credit underwriting, enabling banks to process up to 5x more loans without additional headcount and integrate third-party data via its Data Marketplace.

overview_description.description: Taktile develops an AI-based decision platform for financial institutions to manage risk-related processes across the customer lifecycle. Its platform enables teams to design, test, deploy, and optimize decision strategies for customer onboarding, credit underwriting, fraud detection, anti-money laundering investigations, and transaction monitoring. Taktile combines automated workflows, configurable business rules, third-party data integrations, and human review capabilities to support decision-making in regulated environments. The platform also provides tools for experimentation, performance monitoring, and case management, allowing organizations to evaluate and refine their decision processes over time. Taktile serves banks, insurers, and financial technology companies seeking to automate and govern operational and risk decisions.

about_short_description.short_description: Taktile is an AI decision platform for financial institutions, aiding them in automating and enhancing their risk management strategies.

product.name: Taktile Agentic Decision Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for designing, automating, monitoring, and governing AI-assisted decisions across onboarding, underwriting, fraud, compliance, and claims.

product.name: Decision Engine
product.description: A low-code environment for building, testing, deploying, and optimizing automated AI and rules-based decision strategies.

product.name: AI Agent Manager
product.description: A management environment for deploying and controlling configurable AI agents that automate repetitive work in financial services workflows.

product.name: Case Manager
product.description: An integrated case management system for creating, routing, investigating, and resolving financial services cases with AI and human review.

product.name: Context Layer
product.description: A data orchestration and entity intelligence layer that connects internal, external, and third-party sources to produce decision-ready customer and business data.

product.name: Data Marketplace
product.description: A marketplace of pre-integrated data providers and connectors for credit, compliance, fraud, onboarding, insurance, and other decisioning use cases.
